contract.name: gfd-traffic-intelligence-gold
notes: Sources are never combined into a visitors total.
Windows are precomputed; the UI must not rebuild totals by summing series.

definitions.text: Pipeline-owned. In this contract, 'visitor' appears only as a GA4 or first-party grain when the source actually emits it. It is not an edge unique and is not comparable to Cloudflare uniques.
knownLimitations: Not interchangeable with user, session, or edge unique.

definitions.text: Pipeline-owned GA4 user (client-id based, source-defined). Not a person count and not an edge unique.
knownLimitations: Consent, ad-block, and cookieless traffic undercount this grain.

definitions.text: Pipeline-owned session as defined by the emitting source (GA4 session or RUM session). Sources do not share a session definition.
knownLimitations: GA4 sessions and RUM sessions are not the same object.

definitions.text: Pipeline-owned. Cloudflare edge page views, Cloudflare RUM page views, and GA4 views are three different grains and must be labeled by source.
knownLimitations: Do not compare raw pageview counts across sources without reading grain.

definitions.text: Pipeline-owned evidence class, not a census. Human evidence is browser-side (RUM, GA4, first-party). Edge traffic is not classified as human by default.
knownLimitations: Absence of bot signals is not proof of a human.
Headless browsers can emit browser-like events.

definitions.text: Pipeline-owned automation class from the emitting source's taxonomy. Not a moral category and not equivalent to threat.
knownLimitations: Taxonomy coverage is incomplete; unclassified remains large.

definitions.text: Pipeline-owned class: automated fetching attributed to an AI training or retrieval crawler (for example GPTBot, ClaudeBot) via the canonical actor table.
knownLimitations: User-agent spoofing and shared infrastructure cause both false positives and false negatives.

definitions.text: Pipeline-owned class covering AI assistants and user-triggered agents (for example ChatGPT-User) as distinct from training crawlers.
knownLimitations: Operator-triggered fetches and assistant browsing are easy to confuse without actor tables.

definitions.text: Pipeline-owned Cloudflare threat event as emitted by the edge security product. Not a bot count and not a human count.
knownLimitations: Threat ≠ bot ≠ AI crawler. Do not treat threat rate as an automation share.

definitions.text: Pipeline-owned interval or qualitative note attached to a metric. The UI must display it and must not invent a confidence score.
Cloudflare HTTP request counted at the edge, including humans, automation, health checks, and blocked threats as the product counts them.
Cloudflare edge page view as defined by Cloudflare zone analytics. Not a RUM page view and not a GA4 view.
knownLimitations: HTML-ish responses only; bots can generate edge page views.

definitions.text: Cloudflare Web Analytics (RUM) page view from a browser beacon. Sampled.
knownLimitations: Requires JS execution; automation without a full browser is invisible.

definitions.text: GA4 session as defined by GA4. Sampled under standard GA4 collection.
knownLimitations: Consent mode, ad blockers, and server-side tagging change this count.

definitions.text: Pipeline-modeled share of edge requests that show human evidence. Estimate only.
knownLimitations: Overlapping evidence and missing RUM make the interval wide.

anomalies.title: Edge volume spike on goodflippindesign.com
anomalies.detail: Pipeline flagged 12,400 edge requests on 2026-09-01 against a typical ~4.5k day. Correlated with a Pages deploy.

anomalies.title: Pages deploy correlated with edge spike
anomalies.detail: goodflippindesign Pages deploy timestamp aligns with the 2026-09-01 request spike. Pipeline does not claim causality beyond correlation.

anomalies.title: Threat spike
anomalies.detail: 210 threat events on 2026-08-22 (typical ~45). Scanner-like paths (/wp-login.php) dominate.

anomalies.title: Error spike
anomalies.detail: 88 error responses on 2026-08-18. Pipeline marks origin 5xx cluster on culturesherpa.org.

anomalies.title: Edge up, GA4 down
anomalies.detail: Edge requests rose while GA4 sessions fell on 2026-08-28. Expected when automation grows. Not a tracking outage by itself.

anomalies.title: AI-classed request spike
anomalies.detail: 2,100 AI-classed edge requests on 2026-09-04. GPTBot + ClaudeBot dominate.

anomalies.title: Scanner / hostile overlap with threats
anomalies.detail: Same day as the threat spike. Pipeline keeps bot and threat as separate classes.

anomalies.title: Ireland concentration in AI geography
anomalies.detail: Ireland is #2 in AI-classed edge geography. Pipeline notes this is typical of cloud egress, not Irish readers.

opportunities.title: AI Aimate has crawler demand and thin human evidence
opportunities.detail: Edge AI-classed requests dwarf RUM/GA4 on aiaimate.com. Pipeline does not convert that into a visitor opportunity by itself — it flags a content/distribution gap.
opportunities.action: Inspect AI actor pages vs human landing pages.

opportunities.title: GFD carries most browser-observed activity
opportunities.detail: RUM and GA4 both concentrate on goodflippindesign.com. Human-evidence work should start there, not on edge-heavy personal domains.
opportunities.action: Open the humans view filtered to gfd.

disagreement.label: Page views / views (not the same grain)
disagreement.grainNote: edge_pageview vs rum_pageview vs GA4 views vs Vercel — do not reconcile by addition.
disagreement.note: Disagreement is expected. Edge counts automation; RUM/GA4 require a browser; Vercel covers a minority of hosts.

disagreement.label: Identity-like grains
disagreement.grainNote: GA4 users vs RUM sessions vs edge requests. These are different objects.
disagreement.note: If these numbers ever match, treat it as coincidence until the pipeline says otherwise.

definitionNotes: Visitor, user, session, and pageview are source-defined. The laboratory exists to keep them from collapsing into one number.
Sample factor of 1 still means SAMPLED when the collection method is a browser beacon or GA4 hit.
Modeled human-share is an estimate with an interval. It is not an input to other cards.

disagreement.grainNote: edge_pageview vs rum_pageview vs GA4 views vs Vercel — do not reconcile by addition.
disagreement.note: Disagreement is expected. Edge counts automation; RUM/GA4 require a browser; Vercel covers a minority of hosts.

disagreement.label: Identity-like grains
disagreement.grainNote: GA4 users vs RUM sessions vs edge requests. These are different objects.
disagreement.note: If these numbers ever match, treat it as coincidence until the pipeline says otherwise.

definitionNotes: Visitor, user, session, and pageview are source-defined. The laboratory exists to keep them from collapsing into one number.
Sample factor of 1 still means SAMPLED when the collection method is a browser beacon or GA4 hit.
Modeled human-share is an estimate with an interval. It is not an input to other cards.
